module_purpose: The main purpose of this module is to introduce students to the fundamental principles and theories of geomorphological forces and processes, examining their impact at both local and global scales. Additionally, the module aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of cartography as both an artistic and scientific discipline, enabling them to independently produce their own maps.
